definitions.explanation: A long-legged crab from the cold waters of the Sea of Japan, one of the most prized winter delicacies in Japan and the crab most often served whole at restaurants and ryokan.

examples.japanese: ズワイ{蟹|がに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
ズワイ{蟹|がに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|ほそ}くて→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: Snow crab has thin, long legs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ズワイ{蟹|がに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フル⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: In winter, this ryokan's full-course snow crab meal is popular.

notes:
ズワイ{蟹|がに} is the standard snow crab, sold nationwide; regional catches of the same species carry their own brand names, such as ⟦{越前|えちぜん}{蟹|がに}→越前蟹：30912_echizengani⟧ (Fukui) and ⟦{松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに}→松葉蟹：30913_matsubagani⟧ (Tottori/San'in).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ズワイ{蟹|がに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧: snow crab legs
- ズワイ{蟹|がに}⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: snow crab hot pot
- ゆでズワイ{蟹|がに}: boiled snow crab
